summary: PulseGuard v0.6.20 is a focused UI/readability correction: true runtime 50/50 Optimize panels, readable Stability and Health cards, and clearer current-versus-historical stability details.

sections.heading: Optimize upper deck now truly stays 50/50
sections.detail: Optimization Process and Changes Recorded now live inside a two-column TableLayoutPanel with 50%/50% percentage columns. The layout is recalculated by WinForms after DPI scaling and window resizing, eliminating the autoscale timing issue that could make a source-level 0.50 split render like 75/25.

sections.heading: Stability card text is readable
sections.detail: The dashboard status-card detail area is taller and uses concise monitoring copy. Unexpected shutdown history now reads cleanly instead of clipping a long finding title behind the Details button.

sections.heading: PC Health Score status no longer clips
sections.detail: The health gauge is moved slightly upward and the status note has a dedicated two-line area above Keep it up!/action text. Monitoring copy is intentionally split across two lines rather than being squeezed underneath the gauge.

sections.heading: Stability history wording clarified
sections.detail: Stability Details and the consolidated report now distinguish current/post-fix BSODs and repeated applications from retained historical event counts. The historical top repeated application is named, while current repeated apps are shown separately.
